run_gmock_class_tests: run the unittest test suite for gmock_class generator to verify mock generation
generate_mock_methods_from_cpp: convert C++ class source to Google Mock MOCK_METHOD macro output lines
generate_full_mock_classes: convert C++ source to complete Google Mock mock class source with MOCK_METHOD macros
test_mock_method_generation: test that virtual methods are correctly converted to MOCK_METHOD macros ignoring constructors
test_mock_generation_with_templates: test that templated C++ classes are correctly converted to mock classes with renamed template params
